notes: D-28 re-open (2026-10-10, owner-directed after the reference comparison): surface, surfaceRaised and textSecondary were re-sampled. The first freeze sampled the timeline image at a resolution where frame, surface, surfaceMuted and surfaceRaised all measured the same near-gray (#E0E3E8 family), so the fill scale carried no layering at all and the provider-home cards read as flat gray boxes with a hard edge against the canvas — the opposite of the reference, whose cards are white fills on the gray field, separated by shadow. surface and surfaceRaised now freeze at #FFFFFF (the reference's card/panel fill) and surfaceMuted at #F2F3F6 (the inset-field fill); textSecondary moves from the frozen blend estimate #C5C7CB (which measured ~1.5:1 on the old fill and was effectively unreadable) to #6F7378, matching the reference's legible secondary ink and clearing contrast on both white and the inset fills. canvas, frame, textPrimary and all display tokens are unchanged. This change invalidates the committed Playwright baselines by construction; they are regenerated on the owner's visual pass.

Measured light neutrals read near-neutral with a slight cool bias in the blue channel (canvas #DDE0E5, frame #E0E3E8, surface #E0E3E8). D-01 characterizes the frame as light warm-gray with an olive undertone; in the measured frame family the green channel sits at or a few steps above red, which is consistent with a weak olive (yellow-green) undertone but not with a warm red-leaning gray. Owner to adjudicate the D-01 characterization (UI-SPEC sec 1.4). D-27 sampling method fallback (2026-10-06): ffmpeg 8.1.1 (full_build-www.gyan.dev) is present and ffprobe reads the assets, but this build's mjpeg/yuvj420p decode misrepresents the assets' light neutral range through the filter chain (a canvas window that decodes 223,226,231 under System.Drawing decodes 253,253,253 through ffmpeg's crop/scale chain), so the re-sampling ran through the Phase 001 documented fallback (a): PowerShell System.Drawing region-average, recorded as 'System.Drawing region-average (crop WxH+X+Y, area-average, rgb24)' in provenance.tokens[0].method and provenance.tokens[4].method. Every window read returned exactly three channel values; the 4x4 sub-scan (spread <= 4/255) and the +/-4px horizontal agreement gate (<= 2/255) were applied to those reads with the Phase 001 thresholds. Both records carry visionEstimate: true and require the owner's visual adjudication at the D-27 re-freeze gate (plan 02-01 task-3), the direct analogue of the D-08 gate that closed Phase 001. Until that gate closes, the sanctioned treatment for any control needing a visible edge is surfaceRaised plus shadow.raised (02-UI-SPEC Reviewer item C), and review.gateStatus remains owned by task-3.
